note: Expected profile detection for tests/fixtures/nc/sinumerik-mill (plan M9, WP9.1, roadmap R2). Owner: WP9.1.
One file per folder under tests/fixtures/nc, read by src/lib/core/profiles/detect.test.ts; the margin over
the best profile of another dialect is asserted and printed by src/lib/data/profiles/fanucLathe.test.ts, and
the margin over the turning profile sinumerik, its parent, by src/lib/data/profiles/sinumerikMill.test.ts.
A value is a profile id, or 'fallback' when the content is inconclusive and the current profile stays, or
'refused' when decodeFile does not open the file at all.
Both Siemens profiles share every Siemens marker and the decisive headers, so what decides between them
is what only one kind of machine writes: M6 in a block without a T number, G17/G94, CYCLE800 and the
milling cycles score for milling; DIAMON, LIMS=, G96/G97, TRANSMIT/TRACYL and the spindle-addressed
words score for turning only. A program with neither (a subprogram of plain moves) ties, and the tie
goes to turning (detect.priority -1 here, 0 there). s06-milling.txt moved here from nc/sinumerik/ at M9.
detect-sinumerik-mill.txt carries no extension weight: the content rules alone carry the dialect.
